name: Ongo: Habit Tracker
subtitle: Streaks that survive rest days
promotionalText: Unlimited habits, free forever. Feeling unwell or traveling? Mark a rest day and your streak keeps going. No ads, no sign-up, ready in 30 seconds.
description:
Ongo is a gentle habit tracker that doesn't punish you for taking a break.

Most habit apps reset your streak the moment you miss a day. In Ongo, a sick day or a trip is just a rest day: your streak stays intact. Track as many habits as you like, for free, forever.

UNLIMITED HABITS, FREE FOREVER
• No limit on the number of habits
• Logging, undo, fixing past days and rest days are always free
• No ads, no account, no sign-up

REST DAYS DON'T BREAK YOUR STREAK
• Mark a rest day when life happens. Rest days show as hollow dots and keep your streak going
• "3 times a week" habits with no fixed days
• Choose when your day ends (midnight, 2, 4 or 6 AM) for night owls and night shifts

ONE TAP TO LOG
• Tap the big circle to log. Tapped by mistake? Undo right away
• Count habits like "Drink 2,000 ml of water", and limits like "3 drinks a week"
• Add a short note to any day
• Start in 30 seconds by tapping a suggestion

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
• Current and longest streaks, and completion rates
• A grid of every done day and rest day
• Weekly and monthly rates for every habit

CELEBRATE MILESTONES
• A quiet celebration at 7, 30 and 100 days
• Turn a milestone into a card and share it

LOG WITHOUT OPENING THE APP
• Home Screen widgets: tap to log
• Lock Screen widgets and a Control Center button

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
• Records stay on your device, with iCloud backup
• Export and import anytime
• App Lock with Face ID
• Available in 11 languages

ONGO PRO
Pro adds ways to make Ongo your own. Logging stays free without it.
• Custom repeats: every N days, N times a month, Nth weekday and more
• Multiple reminders per habit, with different times per weekday
• Detailed stats: your year, best days and times, last year compared
• 10 color themes, habit colors, every icon, emoji and your own photos
• Note search and more share card designs

Ongo Pro is available as a monthly or yearly auto-renewable subscription, or as a one-time purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically at the same price unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple Account settings.
